snippet.title: First game created with native audio and haptics on PC, available on Steam | no need for DSX.
snippet.description:
First game created with native audio and haptics on PC, available on Steam | Via DSX

b-Run is an immersive first-person shooter experience focused on environment exploration and high-performance hardware integration. The game places the player in the rubble of an isolated environment, utilizing a circular "bodycam" style perspective to amplify realism. The major technical standout is the native and full utilization of the Sony DualSense controller features running natively via Bluetooth connection on PC.

Key Features

Bodycam Perspective: Circular and immersive camera inspired by the visuals of games like Unrecord and Bodycam.

Aim Control: Native Gyroscope support, with the option for the player to toggle it on or off in real-time.

Dynamic Atmosphere: Tension feedback system during critical moments in the environment, synchronizing heartbeat haptics, audio, and visual feedback (controller LEDs flashing red to the rhythm of the heartbeat).

Arsenal and Tactile Feedback: Three weapons available (Pistol, AK47, MP5). Each weapon features individual Adaptive Trigger profiles and unique haptic feedback frequencies for firing and reload animations.
